text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Immigration Anchorages Notification.
3. The Anchorages set out in the first column of the Schedule are hereby declared to be Immigration Anchorages for the purposes specified against them in the second column thereof.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 3
Anchorages
First column
Second column
1.All terminals and wharves at Jurong Port, 37 Jurong Port Road
For vessels arriving in or are about to leave Singapore, other than pleasure craft and yachts.
2.The following terminals and wharves owned or managed by PSA Corporation Ltd:
(a)Tanjong Pagar Terminal;
(b)Keppel Terminal;
(c)Pasir Panjang Terminal;
(d)Brani Terminal; and
(e)Sembawang wharves.
For vessels arriving in or are about to leave Singapore, other than pleasure craft and yachts.
